events.title: Demo update v1.07S is live! ✨
events.summary: Pushing an Arcane Dash demo update mid-Next Fest is risky, but I have addressed some of the feedback I have been getting. Have no fear, v1.07S is here! Fixed a bug where Esc wouldn’t close the pause menu Ability to skip the end of level score tally Clearer tutorial for move/shoot controls More prominent level names on the end of level screen Background parallax scrolling toggle Thanks to all for the feedback!

events.title: Demo update v1.06S is live! ✨

events.title: Demo update v1.05S is live!
events.summary: Demo update v1.05S Steam Next Fest starts October 19, and the Arcane Dash demo is ready for it! What's new in v1.05S A Wishlist on Steam link is now in the main menu A wishlist link at the end of Episode 1App Icons have been updated for Windows and Linux Try Episode 1 for free Play the first 9 levels as Ilenor, a young sorcerer racing to recover four stolen items and save the land of Glimmelion. 27 more levels, new enemies and epic boss battles await in the full game. Launching November 16, 2026

events.summary: 1000 downloads! 🧙 Absolutely blown away that 1000 people have downloaded Arcane Dash in the first week. Thank you to everyone who has played and given feedback - you've already helped improve the demo! Episode 1 is still completely free. Full game launches November 2026. Wishlist now!

events.title: Small update to the demo!
events.summary: Quick demo update! 🧙 Added auto save to the demo - so it will save at the start of each levelAdded an option to the game over screen to try again from the current level - players will no longer have to start the whole game again! This adds a much smoother experience!Improved the end of episode screen with the game’s launch window - Arcane Dash launches November 2026. If you enjoyed the demo, wishlist now to be notified on launch day!

events.title: Arcane Dash has been submitted for Steam Deck Verification!
events.summary: The Dash is on DeckWe're thrilled to announce that Arcane Dash has been submitted to officially earn Steam Deck Verified status! We have playtested the game extensively on the deck, and we think you’ll be pleased with the results :)That means the game is designed for you to be able to pick up your Deck and jump straight in!✅ Full controller support, mapped and ready out of the box✅ Readable text and UI at native Deck resolution✅ Smooth, stable performance on default settingsWhether you're dashin
